words.note: Extremely common way to say 'impressive/badass', but literally crude, so it's a bit vulgar. The clean versions are 牛 or 牛的. Often typed as NB or 牛B.

words.meaning: to lie flat; opt out of the rat race
words.note: A quiet protest against overwork culture — doing the bare minimum instead of hustling. Not lazy so much as 'refusing to play the game'.
When everyone works harder and harder for the same reward — a rat race with no real winner. Often shortened to 卷: 太卷了 = 'it's so cutthroat'.

words.meaning: to let it rot; stop trying on purpose
words.note: More active than 躺平 — deliberately doing a bad job because you've given up. 'I'm just gonna let it all rot.'
Literally 'touch fish'. Goofing off or scrolling your phone while pretending to work. From the proverb 浑水摸鱼 (fish in troubled waters).
A self-deprecating badge of pride for ordinary employees grinding through the day. Greeting: 早安，打工人 = 'Morning, fellow wage slave.'
Usually typed as the acronym yyds. Hype for anything you adore — a player, a song, a dish. Equivalent to calling something 'the GOAT'.

words.meaning: emotionally shattered; hit right in the feels
words.note: Originally a gaming term (your armor/defense broke). Now: something moved you deeply or wrecked you emotionally — good or bad.
Peak influencer gushing. Usually 'incredible!', but can be sarcastic for incredibly bad. Overused enough that some find it cringe.
From a viral clip of someone mispronouncing 'thank you'. Expresses being speechless, done, or fed up — rarely sincere gratitude.
Short for 社会性死亡. That cringe so intense you want to vanish on the spot. 'I could have died of embarrassment.'
Everyday word for cringe/awkward vibes. 好尴尬 = 'so awkward'. Also spawns the prefix 尬- (see 尬聊, 尬舞).

words.meaning: to watch drama as a bystander
words.note: 'Eating melon' = enjoying gossip/scandal without being involved. 吃瓜群众 = 'the melon-eating masses', i.e. the peanut gallery.
'Versailles' (as in the palace). Flexing wealth or success disguised as a complaint: '唉，钱太多不知道怎么花' — 'ugh, so much money, no idea how to spend it.'
'Buddha-style'. Not caring about winning or outcomes — zen to the point of apathy. 佛系玩家 = a player who just vibes.
Enjoying content, effort, or a game without paying or giving anything back. 白嫖党 = 'the freeloaders'. Mildly shameless.
'Drawing a pancake' you can't eat. Classic move of bosses dangling raises or promotions that never materialize. Pie-in-the-sky talk.
The person who out-hustles everyone and wrecks the curve for the rest of you. The 'king' of 内卷.
The meme for eating your words. You said 'never', then you loved it. The 真香定律 = 'the law of true fragrance' — everyone caves eventually.

words.meaning: to be hooked; go to your head
words.note: Obsessed with something — a game, a song, a crush. Also literally: booze 'going to your head'. 这游戏太上头了 = 'this game is so addictive'.

words.meaning: to have it totally handled; nail it
words.note: To control something perfectly or read someone completely. 拿捏了 = 'nailed it' / 'got them wrapped around my finger'.
Half-joking, half-respectful term for someone highly skilled. In games it's the carry/pro. 求带，大佬! = 'carry me, please, master!'
Gamer staple. 你好菜 = 'you're trash'. 菜鸟 = a newbie/rookie. The opposite of 大佬.

words.meaning: to screw over a teammate; a liability
words.note: In games: a teammate who drags you down, or the act of sabotaging your own team. 别坑我 = 'don't throw the game for me'.

words.meaning: to feed; hand the enemy free kills
words.note: MOBA slang: dying pointlessly and 'gifting' the enemy an advantage. 别送了! = 'stop feeding!'
Grinding to raise your rank/rating. The opposite is 掉分 (drop rank). 带我上分 = 'carry me up the ranks'.

words.meaning: to squad up on voice chat
words.note: Playing as a premade party, usually talking on voice. 晚上开黑? = 'wanna squad up tonight?'
'Lying-down victory' — your team carries you to the win while you do almost nothing. Guilt-free freeloading (see 白嫖).
A strong player 'leading/carrying' the others. 带带我 = 'carry me'. Closely tied to 大佬 and 上分.
Literally 'switch on cheats'. Also a compliment when someone plays so well it looks fake: 他像开了挂 = 'he's playing like he's hacking'.

words.meaning: to show off; a flashy play
words.note: From English 'show'. 秀操作 = showing off slick moves/mechanics. Can be admiring or a sarcastic 'okay, show-off'.
溜 (smooth/slick) sounds like 6. Spamming 666 in chat means 'nice!' / 'so pro!'. The more sixes, the more hype.

words.meaning: we're done for; it's over; we're cooked
words.note: 'Barbecue' = 完蛋了 (burnt to a crisp). A playful, cartoonish way to say a situation is hopeless. 芭比Q了! = 'welp, we're toast!'

words.meaning: go! keep it up! you got this!
words.note: Literally 'add oil/fuel'. The all-purpose cheer of encouragement, for exams, matches, life. Warm and everywhere.
Everyday admiration — skilled, powerful, or intense. 你太厉害了! = 'you're amazing!'. Can also mean severe (病得厉害 = badly ill).

words.meaning: to stand someone up; flake on plans
words.note: 'To release pigeons'. Bailing at the last minute. 鸽 by itself has become a verb: 我被鸽了 = 'I got stood up'.
Baby-talk mangling of 真的假的 ('really or not?'). Deliberately cutesy, cartoon-voice disbelief. Peak 2020s soft-cutesy internet-speak.
Borrowed straight from English 'emo'. Used as a verb: 我emo了 = 'I'm feeling low/moody tonight'. Usually a passing blue mood.
Beyond 'fragrant' — a 值了/爽 vibe of satisfaction or value. 这个价格真香 = 'what a steal'. See also 真香.
'Second' used as a verb. 秒了 = crushed it instantly / insta-killed. 秒回 = reply the second you message. 秒懂 = get it immediately.

words.meaning: to dawdle; be sluggish and indecisive
words.note: Northern colloquial. 别磨叽了 = 'quit dragging your feet'. About slowness and dithering, not laziness.
Trustworthy and sensible. 他很靠谱 = 'he's solid'. The opposite, 不靠谱, means flaky/unreliable/sketchy.
Something that performs and lives up to the hype. 这装备太给力了 = 'this gear is so clutch'. Opposite: 不给力 (weak/disappointing).
Literally 'dirt/earthy' → unfashionable, cringe-old-school. 有点土 = 'kinda tacky'. 土味情话 = cheesy pickup lines.
Someone or something everyone wants. 你现在是香饽饽 = 'you're in hot demand right now'. Originally a tasty steamed bun.
A pun on 绷不住了 ('can't keep a straight face') using the city name 蚌埠. Means you're losing it — cracking up or welling up.
A surprised exclamation, like 'mamma mia!'. Cutesy, a little dramatic. 妈耶，吓死我了 = 'omg, you scared me to death'.
Short for 社交恐惧 (social phobia). 我社恐 = 'I have social anxiety'. The upbeat opposite is 社牛 — a fearless social butterfly.
Calling someone 秀儿 means 'wow, look at this smart aleck' — admiring or gently mocking a flashy/clever move. From 秀 (to show off).

words.meaning: to ship a couple; obsess over a pairing
words.note: CP = 'couple/coupling'. 嗑 (originally 'to crack seeds') = to devour a ship obsessively. 我嗑这对! = 'I ship these two so hard!'
'Anything's fine' — but watch the tone: a flat, clipped 随便 can secretly mean 'I'm annoyed, figure it out yourself'.
麻烦你了 = 'sorry to trouble you / thanks for the help'. 太麻烦 = 'what a pain'. Both a noun-feeling and a polite verb.
A mild exclamation of frustration or surprise — softer, semi-polite stand-in for stronger curses. 靠，又输了 = 'damn, lost again'.
That deeply satisfying feeling — a cold drink on a hot day, a clutch win. 太爽了! = 'so satisfying!'. 不爽 = displeased/annoyed.
Clipped from 尴尬. Now a productive prefix: 尬聊 = painfully awkward small talk, 尬舞 = cringe-worthy dancing, 尬住 = frozen in awkwardness.
Written register; 慢慢 is the everyday spoken version.
Often opens a clause: 显然，这行不通.
承认错误 = admit a mistake; 承认现实 = face reality.
不容忽视 = not to be overlooked.
培养兴趣 / 培养人才.
Formal: 具备条件 = meet the requirements.
促进发展 / 促进交流.
弥补损失 / 弥补不足.
Both verb and noun; usually negative: 遭遇困难.
Written; 频繁发生 = happen repeatedly.
迫切需要 = urgently need.
形势严峻 = the situation is grim.
缓解压力 / 缓解矛盾.
News/formal register for 到达.
卓越的贡献 = outstanding contribution.
崭新的面貌 = a whole new look.
恶性循环 = vicious cycle.

奢侈品 = luxury goods.

条件苛刻 = harsh terms.

傲慢无礼 = arrogant and rude.
崇高的理想 = a noble ideal.

经济繁荣 = a booming economy.

贯彻政策 = put a policy into effect.

削弱实力 = sap one's strength.

产业转型 = industrial upgrading.

借鉴经验 = learn from others' experience.
秉持理念 = stay true to a principle.
恪守承诺 = keep one's word faithfully.
违背原则 = betray a principle.
高度契合 = a close fit.
涵盖范围 = the scope covered.
渲染气氛 = build up the mood/hype.
蕴含深意 = carry a deeper meaning.
Gradual, unnoticed shaping of someone over time.

words.meaning: to live up to one's name
words.note: 名副其实的专家 = an expert worthy of the title.
一如既往地支持 = support as steadfastly as ever.
Quitting before finishing what you started.
Throw everything you have at it.
Making something already good even better.

words.meaning: help in a time of need
words.note: Literally 'sending coal in the snow' — timely aid.

words.meaning: to overdo it; ruin by excess
words.note: 'Draw legs on a snake' — a needless, spoiling addition.
Mend the pen after losing sheep — fix it before more harm.
Not the slightest carelessness.
Steady, practical, no shortcuts.
Ambitions that outstrip one's actual skill.
Never settling, always refining.
Not worth it — the cost exceeds the benefit.
The moment it all clicks.
Known to every family.
New cases/versions keep appearing.
Trying everything to reach a goal.
Right before your eyes — no time to lose.
Visitors/traffic coming without pause.

words.meaning: to nail it; secure; win over
words.note: 拿下了 = sealed the deal / got it done.
太拉胯了 = totally dropped the ball.
'The house collapsed' — your fave got exposed.

words.meaning: to go viral beyond one's niche
words.note: Breaking out of a fanbase into the mainstream.
顶级流量 — the biggest-draw stars.
我麻了 = so much cringe/shock I've gone numb.
笑死我了 = I'm dead 😂.
真的无语 = honestly no words.
我服了 = I'm defeated — or grudgingly impressed.
就是这个内味儿 = 'that's the exact vibe'.
Phonetic meme spelling of 太酷啦.

words.meaning: to jinx it by declaring out loud
words.note: 立了个flag = tempting fate; the 'flag' then falls (fails).

words.meaning: to pull a stunt; mess around
words.note: NE slang: 整点活儿 = do something fun/wild.
NE dialect: 唠会儿嗑 = have a natter.
显摆什么 = quit flaunting it.
NE slang: 别忽悠我 = don't con me.
Colloquial for 吝啬.
你怂了 = you wimped out.
你好二 = you're such a goof; 二货 = a doofus.
Strong, crude insult (lit. very rude). Often typed SB. Very offensive.
Euphemism for 我操. All-purpose shock; 我靠 is the milder version.
Common strong curse; also just 妈的. Used for anger or as an intensifier.
滚开 / 滚蛋 — a harsh 'go away'.
王八蛋 is stronger.
Literally 'idiocy'; a common insult.
'Waste of space' — a cutting insult.
Lit. mental illness; used as 'you're crazy'. Rude.
Also 'abnormal': 变态难 = insanely hard (slang).
你真恶心 = you're gross; also literally 'nauseous'.
犯贱 = to act contemptibly. Harsh aimed at a person.
Being a poser; 装 for short. Crude.
别扯淡 = quit talking crap.
放屁! = 'bullsh*t!'; 屁话 = crap talk.
太坑爹了 = so misleading/ripoff. Playfully vulgar.
Lit. 'balls ache' — idle frustration or a dumb hassle.
MOBA farming: land the killing blow on a minion.
团战一波 = commit to a full 5v5 clash.
放大招 = pop your ult.

words.meaning: to dive under the enemy tower
words.note: A risky tower dive for a kill.
Steal the opponent's jungle camps.
五连杀 — solo-killing all five enemies.
别挂机 = don't go AFK.
我掉线了 = I got dropped.
好卡 = so laggy; also 'jammed/stuck'.
苟住 = keep your head down and outlast.
一波莽 = send it; opposite of 苟.
演一波 = pretend to be weak, then strike.

words.meaning: to clean up kills; mop up
words.note: 收割战场 = reap kills once fights are won.
别甩锅给我 = don't pin it on me.
我不背锅 = I'm not the scapegoat.
